text:
anya: Heads-up EU edge warm pool dropped ~40% in the last 15m. Many nodes failing to finish bootstrap due to keystore decrypt denies.

sam: snippet from one node boot log: 
```
2026-03-22T09:10:02Z node-212 boot: keystore: decrypt error: AccessDeniedException: Caller not authorized for Decrypt
requestId=efgh-5678 region=eu-west-1
stack: keystore/ephem-signer.go:107
```

anya: looks like ephem-signer talking to keystore-proxy gets IAM condition denies. Nodes never reach Ready -> warm pool shrinks -> scheduler backfills but GPU capacity hit.

julien: did we ship any IAM/KMS policy changes recently?

security-bot: CloudTrail alert: policy change detected 6m before failures. change id ct-2026-03-22-892; principal=infra-ci-role modified condition keys `aws:RequestTag/ephemeral`. Link: https://cloudtrail.example/org/ct-2026-03-22-892

lee: quick cost footnote: cross-region fallback (shift ~30% of workloads to us-west) would incur NAT/egress and cross-region KMS ops; rough: ~ $6k/mo plus peak NAT ~$1k/day. Not free.

sam: keystore-proxy logs show 403s from edge agents: 
```
2026-03-22T09:09:50Z keystore-proxy: auth denied: caller=ephem-join svc=ephem-signer reason="iam condition failed" ct_event=ct-2026-03-22-892
```

anya: sounds like a tightening of the IAM condition that filters ephemeral instance profiles (tags).

julien: we shouldn't widen policy broadly. Proposed mitigation: apply a timeboxed IAM exception scoped to the edge-join role for 20 minutes, require SRE+Sec approval, and patch keystore-proxy to retry on 403s (exponential backoff) instead of immediate abort. Then canary.

lee: tradeoffs: short exception = low cost & quick recovery; cross-region = higher cost and operational complexity. I support exception+retry+canary.

anya: short plan now:
1) sam -> deploy retry patch to staging keystore-proxy and run 2-node canary.
2) julien -> prepare a Terraform change for a timeboxed IAM exception and verify with Sec.
3) lee -> standby with cost estimates in case we need to reroute.
4) anya -> monitor warm pool metrics and audit qps.

sam: patch pushed to staging. Quick test from a node: 
```
curl -H "X-Instance-Role: ephem-join" https://keystore-proxy.internal/health | jq .
{"status":"denied","reason":"iam condition failed","event":"ct-2026-03-22-892"}
```

security-bot: exported CloudTrail snapshot -> s3://redwood-audit/tmp/ct-2026-03-22-892.json (read link).

julien: preparing the 20m exception in infra repo, will not apply until canary green and 2 approvers sign. Jira INFRA-4630.

ops-bot: runbook reference: https://internal.runbooks/keystore-boot step 2b (temp-role-exception).

sam: staging canary (2 nodes) shows retries and one node succeeded after retry. Moving to 10-node canary now.

anya: once julien applies exception for 20m we scale canary to 20 nodes then roll to warm pool if green. Audit qps will spike—consider retention tuning.

julien: applied exception in prod for 20m, link to Terraform diff and CT export in INFRA-4630. Auto-revoke scheduled.

anya: metrics: warm pool recovered +30 nodes in 10m; bootstrap OK. Audit qps ~= 3.5x baseline.

lee: will prepare retention toggle to reduce ingestion retention from 30d->7d for audit-sampler if qps remains >3x for 1h. Estimated savings ~ $2k/day. Will not flip without Sec sign-off.

julien: exception will auto-revoke in 20m. After revoke we must confirm stability; if failures recur we need a permanent fix (policy refinement or onboarding tag flow change).

anya: post-incident follow-ups: exact policy diff, why ephemeral tagging failed, keystore-proxy retry behavior (avoid hard-fail on 403), and cost decision log (reroute vs exception). I'll write the follow-up doc.

sam: monitoring for 2 hours and collecting failed bootstrap CT events to upload to INFRA-4630.

anya: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
